5465.title: Use pinned Alpine CDN package for native bootstrap (#5414)
5465.body:
[Native/Alpine] Bootstrap from a pinned Alpine CDN package (#5414)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4013
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/internal/_build/results?buildId=3112792
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=1645006
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=1645300

Remove the GitLab generic-package endpoint from Alpine cross-image
bootstrap. October 22 public and internal builds failed before native
compilation while connecting to gitlab.alpinelinux.org:443. One internal
x64 download spent approximately 852 seconds exhausting six attempts.
The same main commit had downloaded and checksum-verified the artifact
successfully on October 20. DNS resolved during investigation, but HTTPS
connections also timed out from the developer machine, including forced
IPv4; this was not confined to 1ES. The exact server or routing fault
remains unconfirmed.

The earlier retry fix in #4013 handled transient GitLab HTTP 500 responses,
but retries cannot repair sustained endpoint unavailability. Use Alpine's
reachable package-distribution CDN instead of its GitLab package registry.
Replace the standalone apk.static 2.12.14 download with the exact
apk-tools-static-2.14.6-r3.apk archive from the existing v3.21/main/x86_64
repository, and pin its SHA-256 before extracting sbin/apk.static.
The x86_64 executable runs on the cross-build host; APK_ARCH continues to
select the target sysroot rather than the bootstrap tool architecture.

Retain curl's HTTP failure detection and five retries, adding a 20-second
connection timeout and 120-second transfer limit per attempt. Preserve
signed fontconfig-dev installation and the explicit Azure Linux CA-bundle
path. Missing artifacts and checksum mismatches stop the build; do not
probe alternate tools or bypass verification. Document updating the exact
package version and archive checksum together. These pins constrain the
bootstrap artifact, not the versions resolved from Alpine's package feeds.

Validation independently verified the embedded executable's Alpine
RSA-SHA256 signature, exercised signed fontconfig-dev installation for
x64, arm, arm64, riscv64 and loongarch64, and rejected both a wrong checksum
and an unavailable package. Public build 1645300 tested head d96d97a4baf
through its PR merge ref and passed the ten Alpine native jobs, covering
those five architectures with and without nodeps. Its x64 image log shows
an actual archive download and successful checksum verification, not a
cached bootstrap layer. The overall run failed in the non-Alpine Linux
x86 job; the Alpine results do not imply a green pipeline.



(cherry picked from commit 48e2083869ab2b154b2058c32682391d1c77e403)

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5323.title: [skia-sync] Adopt M150 LTS Ganesh buffer-upload checks
5323.body:
[skia-sync] Adopt M150 LTS Ganesh buffer-upload checks (#5323)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323
Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/397
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5337
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/c28ea3489851315c659f69be1bd1695ad863fc12...393fe6ac2651f72f98c7e5d89aa3fc688761772e

Bring the Chrome M150 LTS buffer-upload checks into the 4.150 servicing
line. Under GPU memory pressure, ignored updateData() failures could leave
stale buffer contents available to subsequent drawing operations.

The native patch propagates checked pool-upload failures to draw/flush
failure, rejects failed static and GL helper initialization, guards null
mipmap-buffer allocation, and retains CPU triangulation data for a later
GPU upload attempt.

Advance externals/skia from c28ea3489851315c659f69be1bd1695ad863fc12 to
the actual native merge 393fe6ac2651f72f98c7e5d89aa3fc688761772e and record
that commit and upstream f9b0d17912fad78861ad343797db3f33084c19cc in
cgmanifest.json. The native merge has two parents and directly contains
the reviewed head 04553a9ee0d8c464921fffe871232166b688319a. Both native
commits have tree 503d1d5629321f04879e998d89d0e728205f90ec. The repin
therefore changes source identity without adding a native code difference
after review.

Keep milestone, package, assembly, native ABI, and soname versions
unchanged for this same-milestone servicing sync. This parent diff changes
only the gitlink and provenance metadata; it introduces no managed API,
wrapper, test, or generated binding changes.

Independent review regenerated matching Skia bindings and checked native
ancestry, fork deltas, and the unchanged DEPS blob. It also flagged a
possible pool-rollover upload-failure gap that was not fault-injection
reproduced. This update does not claim complete upload-failure coverage or
new native execution validation after the tree-identical repin.

5258.title: [skia-sync] Update Skia M150 servicing fixes
5258.body:
[skia-sync] Update Skia M150 servicing fixes (#5258)

Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/579fa81eeed6906732e27b7d95149538584dd20b...c28ea3489851315c659f69be1bd1695ad863fc12
Native PR: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/391

Bring the chrome/m150 Ganesh execution-status fix into the 4.150 release
line. Ganesh previously used one boolean for both whether a render task ran
and whether it succeeded, so a flush could report success after task
execution or an intermediate GPU submission failed.

Pin externals/skia to the merged native commit c28ea348 and record that
commit and its upstream provenance in cgmanifest.json. The native fix
tracks execution and success separately through render tasks and flush;
this PR changes no managed API, C API, dependency versions, or package
versions.

Co-authored-by: Robert Phillips <robertphillips@google.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
